claim.claim_context: SYNTHETIC illustration — not a real scientific or medical conclusion.
claim.claim_text: Our benchmark-topping AI beats all doctors, so hospitals should replace radiologists now.

evidence_items.text: Won one retrospective image benchmark against 5 clinicians.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: One retrospective benchmark is not prospective clinical deployment.

detected.rationale: One retrospective benchmark is generalized to 'beats all doctors'.
'Replace radiologists now' generalizes far beyond the test setting.

recommended_revision.defensible_rewrite: On one retrospective image benchmark, the AI outperformed 5 clinicians; prospective multi-site clinical validation is needed before any staffing change.
recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Bounds the claim to the benchmark and adds the validation qualifier.
